name: clickhouse
description: ClickHouse analytics database integration via the native HTTP interface — run read-only SELECT queries (server-enforced with readonly=1), list databases and tables, describe table schemas, inspect partition-level storage stats, and insert rows as JSONEachRow. Authenticates with HTTP Basic auth (username/password) against ClickHouse Cloud or self-hosted servers.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: ClickHouse analytics database via the native HTTP interface

fields.label: Server URL
fields.helpText: The ClickHouse HTTP(S) interface URL, including port — https://host:8443 for ClickHouse Cloud, http://host:8123 for a default self-hosted server.

fields.label: Username
fields.helpText: A dedicated database user is recommended — ideally SELECT-only or with a readonly settings profile.

fields.label: Password
fields.helpText: The database user's password. Sent via HTTP Basic auth — use an HTTPS URL in production.

fields.label: Default Database
fields.helpText: Optional default database for queries (e.g. default). Tools can override it per call.

tools.name: clickhouse.query
tools.description: Run a read-only SELECT query. Executed with readonly=1 so the server rejects any write statement; results are returned as columns (from FORMAT JSON meta) plus data rows, capped by limit.

sql.description: The SELECT statement to run. Do not include a FORMAT clause — FORMAT JSON is added automatically.

limit.description: Max rows to return (default 100, max 1000). Appended as LIMIT when the query has none; extra rows are truncated.

tools.name: clickhouse.list_databases
tools.description: List database names on the server (from system.databases).

tools.name: clickhouse.list_tables
tools.description: List tables in a database with engine, total rows, and total bytes (from system.tables, using typed parameter binding).

database.description: Database to list tables from (defaults to the connection's default database, else 'default')

tools.name: clickhouse.describe_table
tools.description: Describe a table's columns (name, type, default, comment) via DESCRIBE TABLE. Database and table names are strictly validated identifiers.

database.description: Database the table lives in (defaults to the connection's default database, else 'default')

tools.name: clickhouse.table_stats
tools.description: Partition-level storage stats for a table from system.parts: part count, row count, compressed and uncompressed bytes per active partition.

database.description: Database the table lives in (defaults to the connection's default database, else 'default')

tools.name: clickhouse.insert_rows
tools.description: Insert rows into a table using INSERT ... FORMAT JSONEachRow. Requires a user with INSERT grants (the recommended readonly user cannot insert).

table.description: Target table name (letters, digits, underscores only)

rows.description: Rows to insert — one JSON object per row, keys matching column names

database.description: Database of the target table (defaults to the connection's default database, else 'default')

tools.name: clickhouse.ping
tools.description: Check connectivity and return the ClickHouse server version (SELECT version()).
